_comment: Graph PATCH body for the TRv2 server-side cloud policy. Blocks ALL external accounts and external apps by default. Target: PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/policies/crossTenantAccessPolicy/default . Creating/patching this generates the Policy ID (GUID) that the device profile (avd-tenant-restrictions-v2.json) references. UNTESTED / build-only per Steven 2026-06-22 - do not apply until reviewed.
